parsed.name: 阿吉伦特涡轮分子真空泵
parsed.description: 阿吉伦特涡轮分子真空泵是一种用于抽取真空腔体气体、建立和维持高真空环境的真空设备，常用于实验装置、分析仪器和高真空或超高真空系统。
parsed.description_en: An Agilent turbomolecular vacuum pump is a vacuum device used to remove gas from vacuum chambers and create or maintain high-vacuum conditions, commonly used in laboratory instruments, experimental systems, and high- or ultra-high-vacuum setups.
